mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question ( quiz_id, question_text, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, marks, topic ) VALUES ( #{quizId}, #{questionText}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{correctOption}, #{marks}, #{topic} )
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET question_text = #{questionText}, option_a = #{optionA}, option_b = #{optionB}, option_c = #{optionC}, option_d = #{optionD}, correct_option = #{correctOption}, marks = #{marks}, topic = #{topic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT question_id, quiz_id, question_text, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, marks, topic, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1
